question: classify every recalibration run by where it actually stopped

passed.note: three arms completed, acoustic +2.26 dB, overshoot -1.29 dB

verification_aborted_by_prediction_guard.note: oversized model; prediction saturation stopped the arms at frame 115 / 223

install_rejected_by_L1_gate.note: L1 = 211 from the band-limited excitation; the gate refused before install, which is the intended behaviour

died_at_the_gate_without_a_receipt.note: six captures completed, then the run raised IndexError inside the SNR gate (it globbed recal_*.npz while the files were still raw_*.npz). This is a flow defect, not a model failure; it is fixed.

refused_before_capture.note: the absolute floor gate exited first, so the measured-SNR test never ran; the one run that succeeded needed floor_gate_overridden=true to get past it. Captain flagged this contradiction and it is now removed.

unknown.note: records fragmentary; reported as UNKNOWN rather than guessed

honest_summary: Of 18 runs only 3 reached the three-point: one PASS, two FAIL. The remainder died in the flow (gate order, an IndexError, the L1 gate) and must not be counted as algorithm failures.
